Overview

Lake Charles is a city in LA with a population of 78,000. Southwest Louisiana city with casinos, the Creole Nature Trail, and a petrochemical industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
